charge_port.notes: US: all i5 built for the US from March 2026 have a NACS port; eDrive40/xDrive40 built before then have CCS1 (they shipped with CCS first). One value recorded for the model year; owner to decide how to show pre-March cars.

supercharger_access.notes: US: native NACS port (March 2026 builds on); earlier cars need the CCS adapter.

wheels.notes: eDrive40 Sedan: 19 x 8.5 in aluminum, P245/45R19; the M Sport Package (Style 936M) is the same 19 in size.
